title: Kurwin's Mortuary Key

sources.title: Graveyard (Lower City)
markers: {{Cw|article|described|violence|abuse}}<!--Really needed here - burying alive, murdered children, etc. Actually, "impiety to the dead" also needed, but this is a single exceptional case to make a distinct template-->

summary: Opens the hatch to the Mortuary cellar in the Lower City graveyard.

fields.Acquisition: Valmorba carries it. The hatch is beside the porch stairs at X 31, Y 21. A DC 10 Sleight of Hand check also opens it.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
